name: nevvie-plugins
description: Nevvie's Claude plugins for small businesses that run on talking, not tech.

plugins.name: nevvie-events
plugins.description: The base: your business folder, voice, setup, planning events and participant emails. Install it with at least one channel.

plugins.name: nevvie-hipsy
plugins.description: Hipsy channel: Hipsy's rules check and publishing your events on Hipsy as a hidden concept. Needs nevvie-events.

plugins.name: nevvie-fetlife
plugins.description: FetLife channel: a FetLife-ready event text checked against FetLife's rules, for you to post. Needs nevvie-events.
